summary.text: Jennifer White is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 10 who took office on January 11, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Her career experience includes work as a senior policy and community engagement officer with the Horizon Foundation and as community advocacy director of the American Heart Association.

paragraphs.text: Jennifer White was born in Detroit, Michigan, according to Ballotpedia.
She earned a B.A. from Michigan State University in 2010 and an M.S. in public health from Johns Hopkins University in 2012.
Her earlier career also included work as a program specialist with the NAACP.
White won a seat in District 10 in the 2022 general election, and in the House she has been assigned to the Health & Government Operations Committee.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as an advocate for public health and listed COVID-19 recovery, public health, education, the environment and public safety as policy areas she is passionate about.
